description.value: Yummies & Gyros is a Greek takeout spot in Courtenay serving gyros, donairs, spanakopita, and traditional Greek sides with both meat and plant-based options. The menu includes a 'Family / Camping Bulk' section offering tubs of hummus, tzatziki, bags of pita, and portioned meat — practical for cyclists looking to stock up for the road. Online ordering with a short pickup window makes it easy for riders to grab a meal without a long wait.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the OSM address (279 Puntledge Rd, Courtenay, BC V9N3P9) and phone (+1 250-338-2299) exactly. Online ordering is pickup-only per the website ('Pickup 15 min'), and the menu shows clear vegetarian and vegan items (Falafel Gyros/Donair, Vegan Spanakopita and Hommus, Vegan Baklava) with legend markers. No evidence exists on the website or in OSM tags for bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities.
concerns: OSM address field omits city and postal code; website provides full address '279 Puntledge Rd, Courtenay, BC Canada V9N3P9' which was used for the listing.
Washrooms, bike parking, and water refill are unverifiable from available evidence — on-site confirmation recommended before publishing.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active takeout restaurant in Courtenay with confirmed online ordering, vegetarian/vegan menu options, and a bulk food section suited to touring cyclists stocking up. Core WWC food-stop criteria are plausibly met pending on-site verification of bike parking and washrooms.
enrichment_extras.notes: The 'Family / Camping Bulk' menu category (bulk hummus, tzatziki, pita bags, portioned meat) is a distinctive offering that may appeal specifically to self-supported touring cyclists.
